parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The comment. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: IncludeExtendedProperties
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return extended properties. Set this parameter to `true` to return extended properties or `false` to not return them.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Default value: Asc. Valid values:
- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. Default value: Position. Valid values:
- Name: name.
- Position: position.

parameters.name: TableId
parameters.description: The table ID. You can obtain the ID from the response of the ListTables operation. For more information, see [Metadata entity concepts](~~2880092~~).
